cameras.frustum_boundary: Inclusive NDC [-1,1] on all axes; positive camera depth.
cameras.geometry_conversion: Source Fraction to nearest binary64 once, retaining full world geometry.

margin.square_fit: max absolute right/up projection about the one common center

cameras.pixel_center_convention: NDC maps to (size-1)/2 coordinates; raster samples integer pixel index +0.5.
cameras.raster_depth_ties: Strict nearer update; an equal-depth sample retains the earlier supplied surface.
cameras.scope: Whole-scene geometric raster cameras; no ROI IDs, visibility matrix or oracle input.
